objective: MAKE THIS PROGRAM'S OWN CONTROL-POWER OUTPUT READABLE, BY ARGUMENT AND NOT BY COMPUTE, AT ZERO CHARGED RUNS. BATCH-efcae7 measured a per-component power profile whose every integer reproduces three ways and whose READING does not survive: of the six depth-1 ablation rows exactly one is contingent on the instrument (step_delta, and the OLD suite already had it), one is entailed by the perturbing family's own declaration (message_difference), one is a theorem of the membership key's functional-dependency graph (in_linearized_code), and three record that no declared family looked (primitive, length, block_index). A NOT DETECTED verdict from this goal is therefore a provable impossibility, a coverage gap or a genuine negative, AND THE SINGLE COLUMN IT IS REPORTED IN CANNOT TELL A READER WHICH. This batch computes the object that makes the column readable, in ONE executor task, STATIC AND ZERO-CHARGED-RUN: (1) a static analysis of the committed `adjudicator.serialize()`, PER PRIMITIVE, giving for every ORDERED PAIR of key components whether one is a deterministic function of the other, and re-partitioning every depth-1 verdict of BATCH-efcae7 into PROVABLY UNDETECTABLE BY ANY FAMILY / NOT PROBED BY A DECLARED FAMILY / PROBED AND GENUINELY NOT DETECTED / ENTAILED BY THE PERTURBING FAMILY'S OWN DECLARATION / CONTINGENT ON THE INSTRUMENT -- with the partition BATCH-efcae7 composed PRE-REGISTERED, so that reproducing or refuting it FROM THE GRAPH ALONE is the first deliverable's own falsification test; (2) the depth-2 subsets that BREAK a dependency, named with their argument, so a fifteen-subset lattice is bought by argument rather than by compute; (3) GATED ON (1), on the off-diagonal cells the measured graph marks as capable of carrying information, the family-by-row matrix adjudicated twice -- honest instrument and the per-primitive-blind known-false instrument O-E -- with the COUNT OF DIFFERING CELLS as the honest scalar version of what the round-2 strengthening bought. TWO OUTCOMES ARE PRE-DISTINGUISHED AND BOTH ARE RESULTS: identical matrices mean the profile carries no information about the instrument at all; any differing cell is a place where a verdict IS contingent on it. Claim ceiling: `analyzed`, never `supported`. NO PATH IS CLAIMED NEW FOR EITHER PRIMITIVE AT ANY TIER, NO CRYPTANALYTIC IMPROVEMENT IS CLAIMED, A PASSING CONTROL IS NOT AN IMPROVEMENT, NO SEARCH IS AUTHORIZED, NO SOURCE IS ACQUIRED, NO INSTRUMENT IS REPAIRED, NO IDEA-* IDENTIFIER IS MINTED, AND THE MD5 LANE IS BLOCKED RATHER THAN CLOSED.
